attributes.action: Making the bus 53 a double decker
attributes.additional_details: making the bus 53 a double decker so it is easier for people can get to work, school and college easily.
attributes.background:
Bus 53 should get a double decker.
lots of student and workers take the bus 53 to both work, high school and college, and lots of students are late to school everyday because the bus is too full and the driver is unable to take more passengers, it affects students and workers severely.

rejection.details: This is a matter for the appropriate local authority or Local Transport Authority. You may wish to contact the relevant local council, your own councillor or your MP about this.
